svg.title: scLucid: research questions, study design, shared tasks and evidence
svg.desc: Six overlapping tumor research contexts connect to one bounded treatment-comparison example. Researchers review the study design and inputs, select Q1 with optional Q4 and conditional Q5, and return estimates and evidence gaps to the question. Optional frozen Q4 program definitions can feed Q1 scores; freezing definitions does not establish independent validation. Q5 requires genetic or lineage evidence and a separately supported implementation. All Q1–Q9 task titles appear once. Development maturity is separate from example role. All plots are schematic.

text.tspan: Research entry → Reviewed design → Selected tasks → Evidence back to the question
